bio: Founder of Project Unveiled. This profile is public so every stated belief can be examined, challenged, revised, and linked to evidence.

positions.p: Jesus taught that salvation requires repeating a specific prescribed prayer or verbal formula.
positions.not_p: Jesus did not teach that salvation requires repeating a specific prescribed prayer or verbal formula.
positions.member_explanation: My present position is that Jesus' recorded teaching emphasizes inward belief, repentance, allegiance, following, love, fruit, and lived response rather than one mandatory scripted prayer. This position is open to challenge.

evidence.note: Repent and believe language; no prescribed formula.
New birth, belief, and coming to the light; no prescribed formula.
Important counterevidence because confession and belief are explicitly connected with salvation.

revision_history.reason: Initial public position linked to Truth Trial #000001.

positions.p: Jesus taught that the Kingdom of God is present within or among people rather than only a future external realm.
positions.not_p: Jesus taught that the Kingdom of God is only a future external realm and not presently within or among people.
positions.member_explanation: This is a working theological position that requires deeper lexical and contextual investigation, especially Luke 17:20-21 and the phrase entos hymon.

evidence.note: Central text; translation and audience context remain material to the interpretation.

revision_history.reason: Initial public working position; formal Truth Trial still needed.
